messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — customer ACME-Integrations says their $500 trial credit landed on a stale dev workspace after SSO consolidation. They lost access to the prod org, credit shows on workspace id wks_8f3b (a clone).
Samir Patel: Ugh. Do we have the original workspace id from the onboarding flow?
Maya Chen: They provided two org ids: org_acme_main and org_acme_dev_clone. The billing entry references credit_id: cred_2026_7a9.
Priya Rao: Can you confirm whether SSO mapped the SCIM group to a new workspace and we auto-created the clone? Sometimes SSO provisioning creates a shadow workspace if user email mismatch.
Maya Chen: Yep. Customer says SSO was reconfigured last week. They thought the credits would apply to org_acme_main.
Jorge Alvarez: I pulled a quick audit. Billing ledger shows cred_2026_7a9 applied to workspace wks_8f3b at 2026-11-12T14:22Z. The org field is org_acme_dev_clone.
CS Bot: Ticket #CS-14287 created and linked to thread. Assigned to BillingOps.
BillingOps: Thanks @Maya. Can you paste the account owner email and the workspace ids? We'll run a reverse lookup and check last active sessions.
Maya Chen: Owner email: ops+acme@acme.com. Workspace ids: wks_8f3b (where credit is), wks_a12c (expected prod).
Samir Patel: To expedite, run this query in prod-analytics and share the rows: ```SELECT workspace_id, org_id, credit_id, applied_at, created_via FROM billing_credits WHERE credit_id = 'cred_2026_7a9';```
Jorge Alvarez: Ran it; result: workspace_id=wks_8f3b, org_id=org_acme_dev_clone, created_via='sso_provision', applied_at='2026-11-12T14:22:07Z'.
Priya Rao: That confirms an SSO-provisioned workspace got the grant. Two common fixes: 1) Reassign the credit to the intended workspace in billing backend, 2) Refund and reissue to correct org. Need CS + BillingOps approval either way.
BillingOps: For reassign we need record-of-intent from account owner. Ask them to confirm via the billing email or attach a support authorization. Once we have that we can run a transactional move.
Maya Chen: Customer responded, they confirmed via ops+acme and attached the support auth PDF. They want credits moved, not refunded.
Samir Patel: Ok, escalation plan: 1) Snapshot current billing rows, 2) create migration txn to update billing_credits.workspace_id and ledger entries, 3) invalidate any derived coupons tied to wks_8f3b, 4) audit log entry. Engineering will review migration script before run.
Jorge Alvarez: Drafted migration SQL: ```BEGIN; UPDATE billing_credits SET workspace_id='wks_a12c', org_id='org_acme_main', note='migrated per CS-14287' WHERE credit_id='cred_2026_7a9' AND workspace_id='wks_8f3b'; INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, metadata) VALUES ('credit','cred_2026_7a9','migrated','{"from":"wks_8f3b","to":"wks_a12c","approved_by":"ops+acme@acme.com"}'); COMMIT;```
Priya Rao: Please hold on testing in prod. Engineering needs to confirm no downstream chargeback or reserved capacity link to credit. @Samir can you triage with runtime/ops?
Samir Patel: Will do. Quick note: If the clone workspace has had any usage, token counting may have already consumed credit units. We need to check usage windows and potentially adjust remaining balance, not just move the row.
Maya Chen: Customer says the clone had only a couple of API calls from CI (test webhook). Minimal usage.
BillingOps: Good — that simplifies. We'll prepare a partial-balance migration: capture used_tokens and remaining_balance and update both sides.
CS Bot: Escalation to eng-infra created: ENG-TICKET-6192.
Jorge Alvarez: Eng-infra reviewed. They asked for a dry run against staging dump and checksum of billing_credits before/after. I exported a redacted dump to s3://redwood-staging-dumps/cs-14287-dryrun-2026-11-13.csv
Priya Rao: What's the rollback plan if something goes sideways?
Samir Patel: Rollback is trivial if we snapshot rows. We can run: ```BEGIN; UPDATE billing_credits SET workspace_id='wks_8f3b', org_id='org_acme_dev_clone' WHERE credit_id='cred_2026_7a9'; COMMIT;``` and reconcile ledger with usage adjustments. We'll also keep the audit log to show actions.
Maya Chen: Customer asked for ETA. Can we do this in next maintenance window (tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC)?
BillingOps: We can schedule. Need final ok from eng-infra and CS before executing.
Priya Rao: Approved from product side. Please include a regression checklist: verify balance, token counters, invoice entries, and KMS audit signature.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll run the dry run tonight and paste results here.
CS Bot: Update: ENG-TICKET-6192 status -> in_progress.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. Will keep customer updated and post the confirmation once migration is done. :thumbsup:
